description: This is a Java source file defining the OrderBuilder class, which provides a builder pattern for constructing Order objects within the OpenMRS API project, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate the creation and configuration of Order objects, mainly used for testing in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: OrderBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with default context-derived services and a new Order object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Returns the constructed Order object after configuration.

methods.name: withAction
methods.description: Sets the action for the Order object.

methods.name: withPatient
methods.description: Associates a patient with the Order by patient ID.

methods.name: withConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept for the Order by concept ID.

methods.name: withCareSetting
methods.description: Assigns a care setting to the Order by care setting ID.

methods.name: withOrderer
methods.description: Sets the orderer for the Order based on order ID.

methods.name: withEncounter
methods.description: Associates an encounter with the Order.

methods.name: withDateActivated
methods.description: Sets the activation date for the Order.

methods.name: withOrderType
methods.description: Defines the Order type using its ID.

methods.name: withUrgency
methods.description: Specifies the urgency level of the Order.

methods.name: withScheduledDate
methods.description: Sets a scheduled date for the Order.

methods.name: withOrderGroup
methods.description: Associates an OrderGroup with the Order.
